title: Inzwi Rakabatana Nemakomo
intro: Mweya wakarurama wakapihwa zvipo zvinoshamisa kubva kudenga, uchiva mutongi uye murwi ane hunhu hwacho hwairatidzika kunge hwakabatana nezvisikwa pachazvo. Nyaya yavo inobatanidza huporofita, umambo, uye hunyanzvi, zvichisiya nhaka inodzokororwa mumapeji ezvakazarurwa naMwari.
clues: Ndakasarudzwa semuranda waAllah ndikapihwa humambo hwakasimba pakati pevanhu vakasarudzwa.
Makomo neshiri zvaizoitawo zvakafanana neni mukukudza Wokumusorosoro.
Simbi yakanyorova sevhu mumaoko angu, nekuda kwaMwari chete.
Ndakagadzira nhumbi dzekudzivirira dzaidzivirira varwi panguva yehondo.
Ndakambopasa muedzo wakaoma apo vaviri vaikakavadzana vakapinda munzvimbo yangu yekunamatira vasingatarisiri.
Ndinotaurwa pamwe chete nemutongi akaraira mhepo nemajini — nekuti mutongi iyeye aive mwana wangu chaiye.

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
